lines.en: label mollyspring3:
scene noonsky
Molly MacCormack was Irish.
lines.zh: Molly MacCormack 是爱尔兰人。

lines.en: Massive reveal, I know. But seeing as it’s relevant to today’s scenario, I figured I’d just remind you now and get it out of the way.
lines.zh: 我知道，这爆料挺重磅的。不过既然这和今天的剧情有关，我想干脆现在就提醒你一下，先把这事说清楚。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes1
Anyway, with the groundwork in place and a baseline level of understanding hopefully established, we come now to the setting of our next injection of Decorated Melancholy.
lines.zh: 总之，铺垫已经就位，基本的共识但愿也已经建立，我们这就来到下一剂「装点过的忧郁」的舞台。

lines.en: It’s a new designer drug that has just hit the streets and is now making everyone joyously depressed, as contradictory as that may seem to you suburban folk.
lines.zh: 这是一种刚流入街头的新式合成毒品，正让所有人都陷入欢快的抑郁之中——对你们这些郊区人来说，这听上去大概挺矛盾。

lines.en: Here are two addicts now — two girls obsessed with the highs and lows that come from the manifestations of tonal whiplash, but each for their own reasons. And each with their own goals.
lines.zh: 现在这里有两个瘾君子——两个沉迷于基调急转所带来的高潮与低谷的女孩，只是各有各的理由。也各有各的目标。

lines.en: Today, however, those goals aligned. And they fully intended to strip and cosplay and touch each other in the privacy of a fitting room. Just two of those were truths and one was a lie.
lines.zh: 不过今天，她们的目标一致了。她们打算在试衣间的私密空间里脱光、换装、彼此抚摸。只不过这三件事里两句是实话，一句是谎话。

lines.en: It’s easy to lie about the future, though. Or things you cannot see. Which is one more reason we need to acknowledge the Irish elephant in the room.
lines.zh: 不过，对未来的事撒谎很容易。或者对看不见的事撒谎。这也是我们得把屋里那头爱尔兰大象指出来的又一个理由。

lines.en: Because no matter how badly she wanted it, and no matter how deeply she felt it, Molly MacCormack would always be lying when she told herself she belonged here.
lines.zh: 因为不管她有多渴望，也不管她感受有多深，每当 Molly MacCormack 告诉自己她属于这里时，她都在撒谎。

lines.en: And all it took to let everyone else know was a single glance.
lines.zh: 而要让其他人知道这一点，只需要一个眼神。

lines.en: : Are you sure this place is going to have lingerie? It seems kind of tame at first glance.
lines.zh: : 你确定这里会卖情趣内衣吗？乍一看感觉挺保守的。

lines.en: : Aye. There’s a section behind that curtain over there with more {i}risque{/i} costumes.
lines.zh: : 是的。那边的帘子后面有个区，放着更{i}大胆{/i}的服装。

lines.en: : We just need to wait for the right opportunity to enter since we’re still in high school and they don’t want us to be horny yet.
lines.zh: : 我们只需要等个合适的时机进去就行，毕竟我们还在上高中，他们还不希望我们发情。

lines.en: : That’s actually really unfair when you realize that this is probably the horniest segment of our lives.
lines.zh: : 想想看，这大概是我们这辈子欲望最旺盛的阶段，这其实挺不公平的。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes2
: Good point. Excuse me! Can we-
lines.zh: : 有道理。不好意思！我们能不能——

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes3
: Wow! Nihongo jouzu desu ne!
lines.zh: : 哇！你的日语真好呢！

lines.en: : Uh...thank you. But I was about to ask if-
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢。不过我刚想问——

lines.en: : Where are you from?
lines.zh: : 你从哪里来？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes4
: Ireland. Can my friend and I go look through the 18+ section, please?
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰。请问我和我朋友可以去 18+ 区看看吗？

lines.en: : Excuse me, can you tell your Irish friend that section is for adults only?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你能不能告诉你这位爱尔兰朋友，那个区只对成年人开放？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes5
: Wait, are you talking to {i}me?{/i} Why? She’s speaking in perfect Japanese.
lines.zh: : 等等，您是在跟{i}我{/i}说话吗？为什么？她的日语说得很好啊。

lines.en: : It’s just easier for you to understand. I don’t want to confuse her.
lines.zh: : 这样你说起来更容易懂。我不想把她弄糊涂了。

lines.en: : She’s fluent, though.
lines.zh: : 可她很流利啊。

lines.en: : I actually live here.
lines.zh: : 我其实是住在这儿的。

lines.en: : Wow! Nihongo jouzu desu ne! For school? How long are you staying?
lines.zh: : 哇！你的日语真好呢！来留学的吗？你打算待多久？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes6
: Forever. Though, it’s not like there’s much of an option to begin with at the moment.
lines.zh: : 永远。不过，眼下我也没什么别的选择就是了。

lines.en: : Forever? Sugoi. Why are you studying Japanese? Do you like anime?
lines.zh: : 永远？好厉害。你为什么学日语？喜欢动漫吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But-
lines.zh: : 是的。不过——

lines.en: : Excuse me, can you ask your Irish friend how long she’s staying? It’s not really “forever,” is it? Did she use the wrong word, maybe?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你能不能问问你这位爱尔兰朋友她要待多久？应该不是真的「永远」吧？说不定她用错词了？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes7
: What part of “she’s fluent and she lives here” do you not understand?
lines.zh: : 「她日语流利、她就住在这儿」，这话您到底哪一点听不懂？

lines.en: : Is she half-Japanese? Or is she just here to visit you?
lines.zh: : 她是混血儿吗？还是说她只是来看你的？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes8
: Are you even listening?! She-
lines.zh: : 您到底有没有在听？！她——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Ami. You don’t need to get worked up on my behalf.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Ami。你不用为我生气。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes9
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : This is just what happens as a foreigner sometimes. You just have to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 作为一个外国人，偶尔就是会碰上这种事。忍着就行了。

lines.en: : Woooow! Nihongo jouzu desu ne...
lines.zh: : 哇——哦。你的日语真好呢……

lines.en: : This lady might be overdoing it a little, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这位大姐可能有点做过头了。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes10
: A {i}little{/i} is being almost too nice when, if anything, your Japanese is even better than mine.
lines.zh: : 「{i}有点{/i}」都算客气了，要我说，你的日语甚至比我还好。

lines.en: : Can you ask her if I can take a picture? We don’t get many foreign customers here.
lines.zh: : 你能不能问问她，我能不能拍张照？我们这儿很少有外国客人。

lines.en: : Yeah, just let me spend a few years of my life studying even half as hard as she does so I can say it to her in {i}English{/i} like you apparently want me to.
lines.zh: : 好啊，那我干脆花上几年时间，只要有她一半用功，就能像您显然希望的那样，用{i}英语{/i}对她说这句话了。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t know English? Then how do you two communicate?
lines.zh: : 哦，你不会英语吗？那你们俩怎么交流？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes11
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!! SCREW YOU, LADY! WE’RE GOING TO GET DRESSED UP LIKE SEXY CATS NOW AND THERE’S NOTHING YOU CAN DO TO STOP US!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！去你的，大姐！我们现在就要扮成性感猫咪，你拦不住我们！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}we probably should have just entered the 18+ section without asking.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我们也许该直接进 18+ 区，别多问那一句。

lines.en: Molly MacCormack was Irish. And she was constantly reminded of that.
lines.zh: Molly MacCormack 是爱尔兰人。而这一点不断被人提醒。

lines.en: But despite the pride she had of her own heritage, it didn’t shake the feeling that it was used almost mockingly at times. Like a tool or a label to separate her from her surroundings.
lines.zh: 可尽管她为自己的血统感到骄傲，她依然摆脱不了那种感觉：它有时几乎是被当作嘲弄来使用的。像是一件工具、一个标签，用来把她和周遭隔离开来。

lines.en: And while she’d made a name for herself around these parts in particular as someone who really {i}did{/i} live here, there would always be people like this one who simply didn’t understand that.
lines.zh: 虽然她在这一带已经闯出了名气，大家都知道她是{i}真的{/i}住在这里的，但总会有像这位一样的人，就是不明白这一点。

lines.en: It was merely a way of life for her.
lines.zh: 对她来说，这不过是日常。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes12
But the true burden is that this is how it’s {i}always{/i} been. And that she never felt truly at home where she was born either. Which is one more reason she lives in her own world.
lines.zh: 但真正的重担在于，事情{i}一直{/i}都是这样。而且她在自己出生的地方，也从未真正有过归属感。这也是她活在自己世界里的又一个理由。

lines.en: No one can make her feel like she doesn’t belong there.
lines.zh: 在那里，没人能让她觉得自己不属于那儿。

lines.en: : Oisín, what’s the hold-up?! We’re not eating in the {i}classroom,{/i} are we? People are going to think we’re like {i}them{/i} if we don’t have lunch in the cafeteria.
lines.zh: : Oisín，磨蹭什么呢？！我们总不会在{i}教室里{/i}吃饭吧？要是连午饭都不去食堂吃，别人会以为我们跟{i}他们{/i}是一类人。

lines.en: : But I brought lunch from home today and everyone always tries to take it when we go there.
lines.zh: : 可我今天从家里带了午饭，我们一去那儿，大家就总想抢。

lines.en: : Probably because your idea of “lunch” is four bags of Tayto and leftover fifteens. You need to eat better! You need to-
lines.zh: : 大概因为你所理解的「午饭」就是四袋 Tayto 薯片加吃剩的 fifteen 糕点吧。你得吃好点！你得——

lines.en: : What’d you bring for lunch, Molly?
lines.zh: : Molly，你带了什么午饭？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes13
: Huh? What? I didn’t-
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？我没有——

lines.en: : I asked what you brought for lunch. It looks...exotic.
lines.zh: : 我问你带了什么午饭。看起来……挺有异国情调的。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes14
: Oh! Yes, I suppose it is. They call it a “bento” in Japanese. It’s a boxed lunch with a variety of different-
lines.zh: : 哦！是啊，确实。日语里管它叫「便当」。就是一份盒饭，里面有好几种不同的——

lines.en: : Is there, like...raw fish in there then? Sushi is Japanese, right? Or is that Chinese?
lines.zh: : 那里面是不是有……生鱼片什么的？寿司是日本的吧？还是中国的？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes15
: It’s Japanese. They eat other stuff too, though. For example, I learned to make something called “Inarizushi” last night, which is actually deep fried tofu-skin called “aburaage” and-
lines.zh: : 是日本的。不过他们也吃别的东西。比如，我昨晚学着做了一种叫「稻荷寿司」的东西，其实是油炸豆腐皮，叫「油扬」，然后——

lines.en: : Woah, you {i}cook?{/i} I figured you just played games and watched Japanese cartoons all day.
lines.zh: : 哇，你{i}会做饭{/i}？我还以为你整天就打游戏、看日本卡通呢。

lines.en: : I try sometimes if there’s something my dad can’t make. I think it came out okay, though. Do you want some? I’m not really hungry right now.
lines.zh: : 要是我爸爸做不来的东西，我偶尔会试试。不过我觉得做得还行。你要来点吗？我现在不太饿。

lines.en: : Oh, uh...me either. I already ate and I don’t like raw stuff anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……我也不饿。我已经吃过了，而且反正我也不喜欢生的东西。

lines.en: : Okay. But if you change your mind-
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过要是你改主意了——

lines.en: : Wait, are you reading {i}porn{/i} right now?
lines.zh: : 等等，你现在是在看{i}色情{/i}漫画吗？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes16
: Huh? No. That’s just how they draw the-
lines.zh: : 啊？不是。那只是他们的画法——

lines.en: : Aoife, look. That’s totally porn, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : Aoife，你看。这绝对是色情漫画吧？

lines.en: : Hm? I...aah! What are you showing me?! Why’s Molly bringing cartoon porn into school again?! Didn’t she already get in trouble for that once?!
lines.zh: : 嗯？我……啊！你给我看什么啊？！Molly 怎么又把卡通色情书带到学校来了？！她不是已经因为这事挨过一次训了吗？！

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes17
: It’s just a regular manga! And besides, the porn you’re talking about is called “hentai.” At least get the name right if you’re going to accuse me of something.
lines.zh: : 这只是普通的漫画！再说了，你们说的那种色情漫画叫「hentai」。要指控我的话，至少把名字说对吧。

lines.en: : Oh my god, she would know how to say it in Japanese.
lines.zh: : 我的天，她居然会用日语说这个词。

lines.en: : You actually watch that stuff, Molly? Do you not like regular people or something?
lines.zh: : Molly，你真看那种东西啊？你是不是不喜欢正常人什么的？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes18
: Of course she doesn’t like regular people. Colin had a crush on her and she just ignored him because some new game came out.
lines.zh: : 她当然不喜欢正常人。Colin 暗恋过她，结果就因为出了个新游戏，她直接把人家晾一边了。

lines.en: : The backpack kid? With the weird metal headband who’s always rushing everywhere?
lines.zh: : 那个背包小孩？戴着奇怪的金属发带、成天到处赶来赶去的那个？

lines.en: : Yeah, they’re perfect for each other. I think his dad died too so their parents could get together as well.
lines.zh: : 对，他们俩简直是绝配。我听说他爸爸也死了，这样双方的家长就能凑一对了。

lines.en: : Too far, Aoife. Too far.
lines.zh: : 太过分了，Aoife。太过分了。

lines.en: : What do you mean? I like Molly. She’s just weird, but in a cute way. Like I want to help her be normal and stuff.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我喜欢 Molly 啊。她就是有点怪，但是怪得可爱。就像我挺想帮她变正常之类的。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with being weird? I don’t mind being an outcast if I get to do what I like.
lines.zh: : 怪有什么不好？只要能做自己喜欢的事，我不介意当个边缘人。

lines.en: : So you’re just happy not having any friends?
lines.zh: : 所以你没朋友也挺开心的？

lines.en: : I have friends online. We’re grinding heroics after school today to gear up a new recruit.
lines.zh: : 我在网上有朋友。今天放学后我们要刷英雄副本，给新来的刷装备。

lines.en: : Translation — I don’t have any friends. Come on, Orla. Let’s go to the cafeteria and let the weeaboo read her Japanese cartoon porn without us getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 翻译一下——我没有朋友。走吧，Orla。我们去食堂，别在这儿碍着这位死宅看她的日本卡通色情书。

lines.en: : Do you want us to bring you back anything, Molly? Like, {i}actual{/i} food?
lines.zh: : Molly，要不要我们给你带点什么回来？比如，{i}真正{/i}的食物？

lines.en: : No thank you. I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我没事的。

lines.en: : If you insist. Would you mind spotting me a few pounds, though?
lines.zh: : 那随你。不过能不能借我几英镑？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes17
: Didn’t I just give you money yesterday?
lines.zh: : 我昨天不是刚给过你钱吗？

lines.en: : Did you? I don’t remember. Either way, your dad is loaded, isn’t he? I just need enough to buy lunch.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我不记得了。反正你爸爸很有钱吧？我只需要够买午饭就行。

lines.en: : I haven’t borrowed money in a while, Molly. You can lend it to me and I can let Orla use it. See how good of a friend I am?
lines.zh: : Molly，我好久没借钱了。你借给我，我再让 Orla 用。看看我多够朋友？

lines.en: : Uh...I guess you can look in my bag if you really need it.
lines.zh: : 呃……你要真需要，就自己在我包里翻吧。

lines.en: : Ew, I’m not gonna find anything weird in there, am I? Because if I see tentacle porn again, I’m telling the teacher.
lines.zh: : 呕，里面不会有什么奇怪的东西吧？要是再让我看到触手色情，我就去告诉老师。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just go through it then.
lines.zh: : 那也许我该自己先翻一遍。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes19
Molly MacCormack knew she was being bullied, but never felt the need to do anything about it since it was mostly inoffensive jabs at her interests and five-pound loans that would never be repaid.
lines.zh: Molly MacCormack 知道自己被霸凌，却从没觉得有必要做点什么，因为那多半只是拿她的兴趣开的无伤大雅的玩笑，以及永远不还的五英镑借款。

lines.en: So long as she could maintain the life she had at home, she’d be “happy.” But happiness here was quiet. And despite how “happy” she was to be alone, that loneliness still burnt at times.
lines.zh: 只要能维持住家里那份生活，她就会「幸福」。可这里的幸福是安静的。而且尽管她对独处感到「幸福」，那份孤独有时依然灼人。

lines.en: Particularly on days like this, where she’d open the doors to an empty home and her voice would echo upon calling out-
lines.zh: 尤其是在这样的日子里，她推开家门，屋里空无一人，喊出口的声音在屋中回荡——

lines.en: : Tadaima...
lines.zh: : 我回来了……

lines.en: As if her father would even know what that meant if he were here to greet her.
lines.zh: 仿佛她父亲就算在这里迎接她，也听不懂这句话是什么意思。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes20
So she’d retire to her room, where she spent the vast majority of her life up to this point, and enter one {i}more{/i} world where it felt like she belonged.
lines.zh: 于是她退回自己的房间——到目前为止，她人生中绝大部分时间都在那里度过——然后进入{i}又{/i}一个让她觉得自己属于那里的世界。

lines.en: Where loans were repaid, death was only temporary, and anyone you {i}didn’t{/i} want to come into contact with could be blocked with the press of a button.
lines.zh: 在那里，借款会还，死亡只是暂时的，任何你{i}不想{/i}接触的人，按一下按钮就能屏蔽掉。

lines.en: That urge to cut people off was a lot less rampant here, however, for {i}these{/i} people were like her.
lines.zh: 不过，在这里，那种想与人断绝来往的冲动要少得多，因为{i}这些人{/i}跟她是一类人。

lines.en: : Stop standing in fire, you fucking morons. Do the world a favor, uninstall the game, and go back to Toontown Online if you’re going to play like a literal child.
lines.zh: : 别站在火里了，你们这群他妈的蠢货。行行好，把这游戏卸载了，要是还打得跟个小屁孩似的，就滚回《Toontown Online》去吧。

lines.en: It still existed, though, because some people were just really bad at online games and it wound up dragging everyone else down by mere association.
lines.zh: 不过那股火气还是在的，因为有些人打网游实在太烂，光是跟他们沾上关系就把所有人都拖累了。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes21
: What do you mean you have projected textures off?! No wonder you’re standing in shit then! Just turn them on! Are you running the game off a fucking potato?! Do better!
lines.zh: : 你说什么，你把投射贴图关了？！难怪你老站在脏东西里！赶紧打开！你这游戏是拿他妈的土豆跑的吗？！给我争点气！

lines.en: : Molly? Can I come in?
lines.zh: : Molly？我能进来吗？

lines.en: : Healer bio! Dad aggro!
lines.zh: : 治疗休整！爸爸拉怪了！

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes22
: Door’s open!
lines.zh: : 门开着呢！

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes23
: Are ya winning, son?
lines.zh: : 赢了吗，孩子？

lines.en: : Dad, what did I tell you about acting out that meme every time you come in?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，我跟你说了多少次，别每次进来都演那个梗？

lines.en: : One day, you are going to laugh. How was school?
lines.zh: : 总有一天你会笑出来的。学校怎么样？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes24
: Normal. Everyone is still an NPC.
lines.zh: : 老样子。大家依然是 NPC。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes25
: Even me?
lines.zh: : 连我也是？

lines.en: : No, you’re a side character. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 不，你是配角。这不一样。

lines.en: : Is that a new staff?
lines.zh: : 那是新法杖吗？

lines.en: : You don’t need to pretend to know what you’re looking at, Dad. Are you making dinner tonight or are we ordering again?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，你不用装作看得懂。今晚你做饭，还是又叫外卖？

lines.en: : If we’re going to order, it needs to be now. I have some business in Belfast in a few hours and probably need to spend the night there.
lines.zh: : 要是叫外卖就得现在叫。我几个小时后要去贝尔法斯特办事，大概得在那边过夜。

lines.en: : Bring back yellowman from Aunt Sandra’s, please. Will you be back tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 请帮我从 Sandra 姑姑那儿带点 yellowman 回来。你明天回来吗？

lines.en: : Early. Can I trust you to not keep yourself awake on energy drinks all night? Because you’re grounded if I come home and you’re still up.
lines.zh: : 一大早就回。我能不能指望你别靠能量饮料熬一整夜？因为我要是回来时你还没睡，你就被禁足了。

lines.en: : Grounding me is a good thing. All it does is remove the pressure I have to leave the house and be the outgoing, social butterfly you wish me to be.
lines.zh: : 禁足对我来说是好事。它唯一的作用，就是免去了我出门、去当那个你所期望的、外向的社交蝴蝶的压力。

lines.en: : And if I take your computer away?
lines.zh: : 那要是我把你的电脑收走呢？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes26
: You wouldn’t...
lines.zh: : 你不会的……

lines.en: : Bed by midnight. Understood?
lines.zh: : 午夜前上床。明白吗？

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes27
: Aye. But I’m not happy about it.
lines.zh: : 是。但我对此并不高兴。

lines.en: : Then how about I make it up to you by letting you choose where we get dinner from? I heard there’s a new ramen shop nearby.
lines.zh: : 那要不我补偿你一下，晚餐吃什么由你选？我听说附近有家新开的拉面店。

lines.en: : Ramen’s never good delivered. All it will do is make me wish for the real thing.
lines.zh: : 拉面外卖从来都不好吃。那只会让我更想吃真正的拉面。

lines.en: : You’ve never had the real thing. We’ve never left Ireland and, according to you, all of the Japanese restaurants here are run by Chinese people who are just-
lines.zh: : 你又没吃过真正的拉面。我们从没离开过爱尔兰，而且按你说的，这儿所有的日本料理店都是中国人开的，他们只是在——

lines.en: : Capitalizing on the trendiness on Japanese food, aye.
lines.zh: : 趁日本料理流行捞一笔罢了，是吧。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes28
: But mark my words...One day, I {i}will{/i} get to experience the real thing. And live out my days as a real Japanese high-schooler and the {i}true{/i} heroine of someone’s life.
lines.zh: : 但记住我的话……总有一天，我{i}会{/i}体验到真正的拉面。然后作为一个真正的日本高中生，作为某个人生命中{i}真正{/i}的女主角，度过我的一生。

lines.en: : You’ll always be my heroine, Molly. No matter where the wind takes you.
lines.zh: : 你永远都是我的女主角，Molly。不管风把你吹向哪里。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Dad. But I’m hoping for a route with a lot less consanguinity and a lot more catgirls.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，爸爸。不过我期待的是一条血缘成分少得多、猫娘成分多得多的路线。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes29
: Yet, somehow, I have ended up with both.
lines.zh: : 结果不知怎么的，我两个都占了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to experience all of that racism out there, nyaa. Would it make you feel better if I let you pet me for a little while?
lines.zh: : 你不得不在外面承受那么多种族歧视，我真的很抱歉，喵。要是让你摸我一会儿，你会不会好受点？

lines.en: : So it fits, after all. I was worried it wouldn’t given your bust size or lack thereof.
lines.zh: : 看来还是合身的。我还担心你的胸围——或者说没有胸围——会穿不下呢。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes30
: Hisssssssss!
: You look very cute, Ami. I truly hope it helps instill whatever sexual feelings you hope to implant in your father.
lines.zh: : 你看起来非常可爱，Ami。我真心希望它能帮你把你想灌输给你爸爸的那些性方面的感觉种进去。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes31

: Why don’t you put yours on? Because, despite what that employee lady might have led you to believe, sexy catgirls are not specific to Japanese culture. You shouldn’t feel ashamed to partake as well, nyaa.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不把你的也穿上？因为，尽管那位店员大姐让你以为的那样，性感猫娘可不是日本文化独有的。你也一起参与进来没什么好羞耻的，喵。

lines.en: : I have never felt shame for even a moment in my life. You have no idea what you are saying.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子连一瞬间的羞耻都没感受过。你根本不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes32
: Well, that’s good. Because I was seriously about to scratch that lady’s eyes out if she Nihongo-jouzu’ed you one more time. You’re just as Japanese as me as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就好。因为她要是再对你说一次「日语真好呢」，我是真打算把她的眼睛挠出来。在我看来，你和我一样是日本人。

lines.en: : I appreciate that. But you don’t need to {i}lie,{/i} Ami.
lines.zh: : 我很感激。不过你不用{i}撒谎{/i}，Ami。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes33
: Nyaa?
: I’m not Japanese. I’m Irish. And I’m {i}glad{/i} to be Irish. Even {i}if{/i} my specific brand of Irishness is still hotly contested by a group of belligerent extremists.
lines.zh: : 我不是日本人。我是爱尔兰人。而且我{i}很高兴{/i}自己是爱尔兰人。{i}哪怕{/i}我这种特定的爱尔兰人身份，至今仍被一群好斗的极端分子争得不可开交。

lines.en: : I know nothing about Ireland but, if that makes you happy, that’s fine by me. I just don’t want you feeling left out.
lines.zh: : 我对爱尔兰一无所知，不过只要这让你开心，我没意见。我只是不想让你觉得被排除在外。

lines.en: scene mollyamiclothes34
: I can assure you I still feel more welcome here than I ever did at home. And that’s even {i}with{/i} the thousands of times I’ve been Nihongo-jouzu’ed.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我在这里感受到的欢迎，比在家里多得多。{i}哪怕{/i}被说过成千上万次「日语真好呢」也是如此。

lines.en: : Woooooow. Nihongo jouzu desu ne.
lines.zh: : 哇——哦。你的日语真好呢。

lines.en: : I will lock you in a cage for good.
lines.zh: : 我要把你永远关进笼子里。

lines.en: : I’d probably be better off in there.
lines.zh: : 我在里面说不定还过得更好。
